command: cd libs/<name> && zig build test --summary all
note: The root `zig build test` runs the same 29 binaries and reports the same total, because the root step compiles the `tests/` roots as well as the inline src/ tests. Re-derive with the command above; a test added without moving this file fails `zig build counts-check`. `poly` went 32 -> 34 when `libs/poly/tests/horner_parity.zig` was added, and `field` 89 -> 91 when `libs/field/tests/merkle_parity.zig` was added; both are counted under the library whose `tests/` directory the file lives in, which is the convention `field`'s own 89 follows.
